notes.title: MEREOLEONA ARRIVES IN BLACK CLOVER: QUARTET KNIGHTS
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33600744/6c4927700bc1c544fc14e1deec11f1ef6827963a.jpg[/img]

She won the character vote and makes now a flaming entry in Black Clover: Quartet Knights…. Mereoleona is ready to burn everything! 

Get her as part of the new [b]DLC: Royal Magic Knight Set – Red[/b], along with a new costume for Asta!

Discover her blazing abilities in the new trailer:
